an4.204:1.1: asappurisañca vo bhikkhave desessāmi asappurisena asappurisatarañca
an4.204:2.2: idha bhikkhave ekacco pāṇātipātī hoti …pe… abhijjhālū hoti byāpannacitto hoti micchādiṭṭhiko hoti
an4.204:3.2: idha bhikkhave ekacco attanā ca pāṇātipātī hoti parañca pāṇātipāte samādapeti …pe… attanā ca abhijjhālū hoti parañca abhijjhāya samādapeti
an4.204:3.3: attanā ca byāpannacitto hoti parañca byāpāde samādapeti attanā ca micchādiṭṭhiko hoti parañca micchādiṭṭhiyā samādapeti
an4.204:4.2: idha bhikkhave ekacco pāṇātipātā paṭivirato hoti …pe… anabhijjhālū hoti abyāpannacitto hoti sammādiṭṭhiko hoti
an4.204:5.2: idha bhikkhave ekacco attanā ca pāṇātipātā paṭivirato hoti parañca pāṇātipātā veramaṇiyā samādapeti …pe… attanā ca anabhijjhālū hoti parañca anabhijjhāya samādapeti
an4.204:5.3: attanā ca abyāpannacitto hoti parañca abyāpāde samādapeti
an4.204:5.4: attanā ca sammādiṭṭhiko hoti parañca sammādiṭṭhiyā samādapeti
